name: Admin Document Folders
description: Organize admin documents through the independent Carpetas propias section. Operator-created roots keep navigation, recursive inventory, rename, archive, delete and reorder behavior regardless of whether entity navigation is grouped by project or client. System-managed project roots stay outside this section but remain valid parents in the folder manager. The 'Nueva carpeta' form's 'Dentro de:' selector defaults to the currently active own folder. Project/client grouping is covered separately by admin-document-navigation; document state filtering remains an independent axis covered by admin-document-state-filters.
